selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific model generation (Classic) and distinguish from other MP3 players or generic rectangles.
To verify the boundary between the metallic iPod body and the translucent plastic case, ensuring no fusion or bleeding occurs.
To check if the tiny text on the click wheel (Menu, Next, Prev, Play/Pause) is rendered correctly or if it suffers from AI text gibberish.
To assess the realism of reflections on the metallic surface and the translucency of the case.

focus_areas: Text legibility on the click wheel

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the click wheel. AI often fails to render these small, curved labels correctly. Also, inspect the edge where the blue case meets the silver body for any 'melting' or color bleeding.
